query:
SELECT count(*) AS "grants!"
        FROM (
            SELECT 1
            FROM unnest($1::text[]) AS caller(source_id)
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT 1
                FROM entity_access ea
                WHERE ea.source_id = caller.source_id
                    AND ea.entity_type IN ('document', 'chat', 'project')
                OFFSET 0
            ) grants
            LIMIT $2
        ) capped
